style.name: Art Nouveau
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick #4: Art Nouveau / 新艺术风格. Build nine distinct premium editorial scenes with flowing whiplash curves, climbing vines, iris and lily motifs, stained-glass translucency, hand-drawn botanical borders, elegant asymmetry, warm ivory, moss green, teal, plum and muted gold. Translate every modern news subject into a different spatial narrative rather than repeating a template, generic sphere, three number cards or dashboard. Content, evidence, diagrams and story scenes occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. Reduce information density by about 20%, emphasize one conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 large readable modules, and keep text on calm low-texture fields with generous spacing. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central living world-tree or flowing botanical globe, using curved stems, layered petals and naturally staggered quiet text fields rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Each overview sentence must remain complete, with clear 1-8 order and no extra event. Chinese and English keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Use only the labels 虾子曰： and 豆豆龙： or Xiazi Says: and Doudoulong:. Put the exact text xiazishuo.com legibly in the bottom safe area of every poster. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and artwork filling all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.headlineView: 企业AI、一人代理服务、AI转售工具、跨境平台、热健康、智能织物、反物质与数字发展进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月22日全球经营雷达；企业AI、一人代理服务、AI转售工具、跨境平台、热健康、智能织物、反物质与数字发展进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. 大众集团已向33万多名员工部署Microsoft Copilot，月活跃Copilot Chat用户超过30万，最近一个月有2.6万多个Agent活跃。
2. 一名单人创始人把自动化代理服务做到验证MRR 12905美元、338个活跃订阅，并自报净利率超过60%、每周投入约5小时。
3. Lista把AI商品文案、服装测量、去背景、幽灵模特与多平台刊登做进iPhone应用，验证MRR 1036美元、113个活跃订阅。
4. Kupinatao以中国商品连接独联体消费者，服务商案例显示月成交额约97万美元、客户复购比例70%。
5. WHO等机构首次推出孕妇、新生儿和儿童极端高温健康优先指标，建议同步监测热暴露与早产、死胎、低出生体重及就诊变化。
6. 一种可触摸发光的数字像素纤维把96×54彩色界面织进袖口，支持视频、传感、无线传输且仍可水洗透气。
7. 物理学家把单个正电子囚禁数月并冷却到最低能态，为更精密比较物质与反物质磁矩建立实验平台。
8. 世界银行集团发布首份数字战略，以连接、可负担设备和数据、数字服务与技能、AI基础四条路径支持发展中经济体创造就业。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是规模、收入和科学突破都要落到可核验的机制上。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 数字很亮，但部署范围、净利润、实验限制和执行成本同样重要。

en-US.headlineView: Enterprise AI, a solo proxy service, an AI resale app, a cross-border marketplace, heat health, smart textiles, antimatter and digital development enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 22 Global Operator Radar; Enterprise AI, a solo proxy service, an AI resale app, a cross-border marketplace, heat health, smart textiles, antimatter and digital development enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. Volkswagen Group has equipped more than 330,000 employees with Microsoft Copilot, with over 300,000 monthly Copilot Chat users and more than 26,000 agents active in the past month.
2. One founder runs an automated proxy service at $12,905 verified MRR and 338 active subscriptions, while reporting above-60% net margin and roughly five hours of work a week.
3. Lista puts AI listing copy, garment measurements, background removal, ghost mannequins and cross-platform posting into an iPhone app with $1,036 verified MRR and 113 active subscriptions.
4. Kupinatao connects Chinese goods with consumers across the CIS, with a provider case reporting about $970,000 in monthly turnover and a 70% returning-customer rate.
5. WHO and partners launched the first priority indicators for extreme-heat risks to pregnant women, newborns and children, linking exposure with outcomes such as preterm birth, stillbirth, low birthweight and care visits.
6. A touch-sensitive digital pixel fibre weaves a 96-by-54 colour interface into a sleeve, supporting video, sensors and wireless transfer while remaining washable and breathable.
7. Physicists held a single positron for months and cooled it to its lowest energy state, creating a platform for sharper magnetic-moment comparisons between matter and antimatter.
8. The World Bank Group launched its first digital strategy around connectivity, affordable devices and data, services and skills, and AI foundations to support jobs in developing economies.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is that scale, revenue and scientific breakthroughs must all resolve into verifiable mechanisms.
en-US.doudouQuote: Bright numbers still need deployment scope, net profit, experimental limits and execution cost beside them.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 大众集团把Copilot覆盖到33万多名员工
zh-CN.headlineView: 30万月活用户与2.6万多个活跃Agent，让企业AI从个人助手走向工程、生产、采购和销售流程
zh-CN.headlineFull: 大众集团把Copilot覆盖到33万多名员工；30万月活用户与2.6万多个活跃Agent，让企业AI从个人助手走向工程、生产、采购和销售流程
zh-CN.intro: 微软10月21日宣布，大众集团已让33万多名员工使用Microsoft Copilot。分阶段部署先从Copilot Chat开始，月活跃用户超过30万；现在员工进一步使用带Work IQ的Copilot，把AI嵌入工程、生产、采购和销售等知识流程，最近一个月集团内有2.6万多个Agent活跃。双方还计划在Microsoft Fabric上扩展统一的Intelligent Data Foundation，让可信数据更容易查找、理解和调用。公开材料证明了覆盖规模和活跃度，但没有披露席位成本、节省工时、决策质量、错误率或投资回报；真正的价值仍要看关键流程的可审计结果与权限治理。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 企业AI的下一道门，不是多发账号，而是把Agent接进可信数据和可追责流程。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 33万人和2.6万个Agent说明规模，不能自动证明效率与回报。

en-US.headlineFact: Volkswagen Group expands Copilot to more than 330,000 employees
en-US.headlineView: Over 300,000 monthly users and 26,000-plus active agents move enterprise AI from personal assistance into engineering, production, procurement and sales
en-US.headlineFull: Volkswagen Group expands Copilot to more than 330,000 employees; Over 300,000 monthly users and 26,000-plus active agents move enterprise AI from personal assistance into engineering, production, procurement and sales
en-US.intro: Microsoft said on October 21 that Volkswagen Group has equipped more than 330,000 employees with Microsoft Copilot. A phased rollout began with broad access to Copilot Chat, which reached more than 300,000 monthly active users. Employees now use Copilot with Work IQ across knowledge processes spanning engineering, production, procurement and sales, while more than 26,000 agents were active across the Group in the past month. The companies also plan to expand Volkswagen's Intelligent Data Foundation on Microsoft Fabric so trusted data is easier to find, understand and use. The release establishes reach and activity, but not seat cost, hours saved, decision quality, error rates or return on investment; value still depends on auditable workflow outcomes and permission governance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Enterprise AI's next gate is not issuing more accounts but connecting agents to trusted data and accountable processes.
en-US.doudouQuote: 330,000 people and 26,000 agents show scale, not automatic proof of efficiency or return.

sources.title: Microsoft empowers more than 330,000 Volkswagen Group employees with Copilot

zh-CN.headlineFact: 自动化代理服务单人运营，验证MRR 12905美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 338个活跃订阅、两家上游供应商与自动开通，把全球网络服务压缩到每周约5小时运营
zh-CN.headlineFull: 自动化代理服务单人运营，验证MRR 12905美元；338个活跃订阅、两家上游供应商与自动开通，把全球网络服务压缩到每周约5小时运营
zh-CN.intro: TrustMRR上的匿名欧洲代理服务由一名创始人运营，向全球客户销售住宅、ISP与4G/5G移动代理订阅。Stripe只读数据验证其MRR为12905美元、最近30天收入23794美元、累计收入328191美元和338个活跃订阅；创始人称已有8000多名注册用户、200多名活跃付费客户，净利率超过60%，每周投入约5小时。交付依赖两家一级上游供应商，自动完成开通、付款、续费、欺诈检测、支持和外联。增长此前主要靠产品自然积累，创始人表示尚未系统做付费广告、SEO和合作；核心成本与风险是上游采购、IP质量、支付欺诈、平台合规、客户支持和对少数供应商的依赖。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司真正的杠杆，是把供应、交付、收款和续费做成无需人工盯守的闭环。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 收入由Stripe验证，60%以上净利率和每周5小时仍是创始人自报。

en-US.headlineFact: A solo automated proxy service reaches $12,905 verified MRR
en-US.headlineView: 338 active subscriptions, two upstream providers and automated provisioning compress a global network service into roughly five hours of weekly operation
en-US.headlineFull: A solo automated proxy service reaches $12,905 verified MRR; 338 active subscriptions, two upstream providers and automated provisioning compress a global network service into roughly five hours of weekly operation
en-US.intro: An anonymous Europe-based proxy service listed on TrustMRR is run by one founder and sells residential, ISP and 4G/5G mobile-proxy subscriptions worldwide. Read-only Stripe data verifies $12,905 MRR, $23,794 in the last 30 days, $328,191 all-time revenue and 338 active subscriptions. The founder reports more than 8,000 registered users, over 200 active paying customers, net margin above 60% and about five hours of work per week. Two tier-one upstream providers supply capacity, while provisioning, payments, renewals, fraud detection, support and outreach are automated. Growth has largely come without systematic paid ads, SEO or partnerships. Upstream cost, IP quality, payment fraud, policy compliance, support and supplier concentration remain the main constraints.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The leverage in a one-person company is turning supply, delivery, payment and renewal into an unattended loop.
en-US.doudouQuote: Stripe verifies the revenue; above-60% margin and five hours a week remain founder-reported.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Lista AI转售工具验证MRR 1036美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 一张商品图生成文案、服装尺寸与模特图，再同步到五个二手平台，靠8.99至19.99美元订阅变现
zh-CN.headlineFull: Lista AI转售工具验证MRR 1036美元；一张商品图生成文案、服装尺寸与模特图，再同步到五个二手平台，靠8.99至19.99美元订阅变现
zh-CN.intro: Lista是一款面向转售卖家和淘货者的iPhone应用，用户建立一次商品信息，即可同步到eBay、Mercari、Poshmark、Depop和Grailed。AI具体用于从照片生成标题、描述和标签，估算衣服胸围、衣长和袖长，并完成去背景、幽灵模特图与虚拟试穿；产品把内容生产和重复刊登压缩成一个移动工作流。RevenueCat只读数据验证其MRR为1036美元、最近30天收入865美元、累计收入22296美元和113个活跃订阅。Starter为每月8.99美元、Pro为19.99美元，也提供年付；获客来自内容营销、Instagram和TikTok。限制包括平台规则变化、测量准确率、生成图真实性、账号风控、应用商店抽成和低价订阅的获客成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI在这里卖的不是一张漂亮图，而是少填五遍表、少拍几组商品素材。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 收入已验证，但平台依赖、准确率和订阅获客成本决定利润。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineFact: Lista's AI resale toolkit reaches $1,036 verified MRR
en-US.headlineView: One product photo becomes copy, garment measurements and model imagery, then posts across five resale marketplaces through $8.99-to-$19.99 subscriptions
en-US.headlineFull: Lista's AI resale toolkit reaches $1,036 verified MRR; One product photo becomes copy, garment measurements and model imagery, then posts across five resale marketplaces through $8.99-to-$19.99 subscriptions
en-US.intro: Lista is an iPhone app for resellers and thrifters that creates a listing once and publishes it to eBay, Mercari, Poshmark, Depop and Grailed. AI turns a photo into titles, descriptions and tags, estimates chest, length and sleeve measurements, and provides background removal, ghost-mannequin imagery and virtual try-on. The product packages content creation and repeated form-filling into one mobile workflow. Read-only RevenueCat data verifies $1,036 MRR, $865 in the last 30 days, $22,296 all-time revenue and 113 active subscriptions. Starter costs $8.99 a month and Pro $19.99, with annual plans available; acquisition comes through content marketing, Instagram and TikTok. Marketplace policy changes, measurement accuracy, synthetic-image truthfulness, account risk, app-store fees and acquisition cost constrain the model.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The AI is not selling one pretty image; it is selling fewer forms and fewer product-photo sessions across five platforms.
en-US.doudouQuote: Revenue is verified, but platform dependence, accuracy and subscription acquisition cost determine profit.

sources.title: Lista: AI Crosslisting & Tools verified revenue profile

zh-CN.headlineFact: Kupinatao跨境平台月成交额约97万美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 把8亿多中国商品目录、订单库存、价格与评价系统连接到独联体市场，70%客户会再次购买
zh-CN.headlineFull: Kupinatao跨境平台月成交额约97万美元；把8亿多中国商品目录、订单库存、价格与评价系统连接到独联体市场，70%客户会再次购买
zh-CN.intro: Kupinatao是面向独联体消费者的中国产品跨境市场，服务商案例称平台连接8亿多件商品、20多万客户和每月1.25亿页面浏览，月成交额约97万美元，70%的客户会再次购买。赚钱机制来自把中国供应端的大目录转成当地可搜索、可比较、可下单的多商家市场，并围绕订单管理、库存、定价、评论采集与搜索引擎索引提高转化和复购。获客依赖Google与Yandex搜索、海量商品长尾页和已有客户复购；履约需要协调跨境采购、支付、物流和售后。成交额不是平台净收入，流量也不等于订单；汇率、物流时效、假货与质量控制、退货、制裁及支付合规是主要风险，数据来自技术服务商案例。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境平台的核心不是目录够大，而是让长尾商品真的能被找到、结账、送达并再次购买。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 97万美元是月成交额，不是净收入；70%复购仍要和履约成本一起看。

en-US.headlineFact: Kupinatao reaches about $970,000 in monthly cross-border turnover
en-US.headlineView: A catalogue of 800 million-plus Chinese items, order and inventory systems, pricing and reviews serve CIS buyers, with 70% of customers returning
en-US.headlineFull: Kupinatao reaches about $970,000 in monthly cross-border turnover; A catalogue of 800 million-plus Chinese items, order and inventory systems, pricing and reviews serve CIS buyers, with 70% of customers returning
en-US.intro: Kupinatao is a cross-border marketplace that connects Chinese products with consumers across the CIS. A provider case reports more than 800 million catalogue items, over 200,000 customers, 125 million monthly page views, about $970,000 in monthly turnover and a 70% returning-customer rate. The mechanism converts a huge Chinese supply catalogue into a locally searchable, comparable and purchasable multi-vendor market, using order management, inventory, pricing, review collection and search indexing to lift conversion and repeat buying. Acquisition comes from Google and Yandex search, long-tail product pages and returning customers, while delivery coordinates sourcing, payment, logistics and after-sales support. Turnover is not platform net revenue and traffic is not orders; currency, delivery time, counterfeits, quality control, returns, sanctions and payment compliance are the main risks. The figures come from the technology provider's case study.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A cross-border marketplace wins not by catalogue size alone but by making long-tail products discoverable, payable, deliverable and worth buying again.
en-US.doudouQuote: $970,000 is monthly turnover, not net revenue; a 70% return rate still needs fulfilment cost beside it.

sources.title: Virto Commerce x Kupinatao Case Study

zh-CN.headlineFact: 全球首次建立妇幼极端高温健康优先指标
zh-CN.headlineView: WHO、WMO、UNICEF与UNFPA要求把温度同早产、死胎、低出生体重、儿童死亡和就诊变化一起监测
zh-CN.headlineFull: 全球首次建立妇幼极端高温健康优先指标；WHO、WMO、UNICEF与UNFPA要求把温度同早产、死胎、低出生体重、儿童死亡和就诊变化一起监测
zh-CN.intro: WHO、WMO、UNICEF与UNFPA于10月21日推出首套针对孕妇、新生儿和儿童的极端高温健康优先指标，目的是让国家能更早识别风险、安排设施并触发行动。现有研究显示，高温暴露与早产几率增加26%相关；2024年一岁以下婴儿经历的热浪日数比1986至2005年基线高389%，全球约15亿儿童正暴露于更频繁、更持久或更严重的热浪。框架建议把气温与早产、死胎、低出生体重、妊娠高血压、儿童死亡、就诊和缺课同步分析。指标用于发现异常信号而不是自动证明单次高温造成个体结局；数据质量、基层记录和本地阈值仍决定可用性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 健康系统只有把热暴露和妇幼结局放在同一张表里，才能从感受高温走向提前行动。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 指标能发现信号，但相关性、记录缺口和地区差异必须被保留。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与健康。

en-US.headlineFact: The first global priority indicators for maternal and child heat risk launch
en-US.headlineView: WHO, WMO, UNICEF and UNFPA ask countries to track temperature alongside preterm birth, stillbirth, low birthweight, child deaths and care visits
en-US.headlineFull: The first global priority indicators for maternal and child heat risk launch; WHO, WMO, UNICEF and UNFPA ask countries to track temperature alongside preterm birth, stillbirth, low birthweight, child deaths and care visits
en-US.intro: WHO, WMO, UNICEF and UNFPA launched the first priority indicators for extreme-heat health risks to pregnant women, newborns and children on October 21, aiming to help countries identify danger, prepare facilities and trigger action sooner. Existing studies associate heat exposure with 26% higher odds of preterm birth. Babies under one experienced 389% more heatwave days in 2024 than the 1986-2005 baseline, and an estimated 1.5 billion children face heatwaves that are more frequent, longer or more severe. The framework pairs temperature with preterm birth, stillbirth, low birthweight, pregnancy hypertension, child deaths, care visits and school absence. Indicators detect unusual signals rather than prove that one heat event caused an individual outcome; data quality, frontline recording and local thresholds still determine usefulness.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Putting heat exposure and maternal-child outcomes on one dashboard turns feeling the heat into earlier action.
en-US.doudouQuote: Indicators reveal signals, but correlation, missing records and local differences must stay visible.

sources.title: New global framework launched to track increasing health risks of extreme heat

zh-CN.headlineFact: 可触摸数字像素纤维把图形界面织进袖口
zh-CN.headlineView: 96×54彩色显示、30帧视频、触控定位、传感与蓝牙集中到一根仍可水洗透气的纤维系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: 可触摸数字像素纤维把图形界面织进袖口；96×54彩色显示、30帧视频、触控定位、传感与蓝牙集中到一根仍可水洗透气的纤维系统
zh-CN.intro: 10月21日发表于Nature的研究把可寻址像素、共轴连接、触控定位和多模态传感集成进数字像素纤维，再织入衣袖形成96×54像素、8位色深的图形界面。原型可运行计算器、体温感知、图像显示、指南针、语音控制和蓝牙传输，视频在无声时达到30帧、有声时25帧，并支持自动旋转和亮度调整。纤维在水下仍能工作，织物保持柔软、透气、可水洗和机械稳定。当前仍是研究原型，分辨率、供电、电子元件封装、批量制造、维修与长期穿着安全尚未达到日常消费品要求。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当显示、触摸和计算沿纤维生长，衣服就可能从设备外壳变成界面本身。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 能水洗的原型很关键，规模制造、供电和维修才是下一关。

en-US.headlineFact: A touch-sensitive digital pixel fibre weaves a GUI into a sleeve
en-US.headlineView: A 96-by-54 colour display, 30-fps video, touch localization, sensing and Bluetooth fit into a fibre system that remains washable and breathable
en-US.headlineFull: A touch-sensitive digital pixel fibre weaves a GUI into a sleeve; A 96-by-54 colour display, 30-fps video, touch localization, sensing and Bluetooth fit into a fibre system that remains washable and breathable
en-US.intro: Research published in Nature on October 21 integrates addressable pixels, coaxial interconnection, touch localization and multimodal sensing into a digital pixel fibre, then weaves it into a sleeve with a 96-by-54-pixel, 8-bit-colour interface. The prototype runs a calculator, body-temperature sensing, image display, a compass, voice control and Bluetooth transfer. Video reaches 30 frames per second without audio and 25 with audio, with autorotation and brightness adjustment. The fibre keeps operating underwater while the textile remains flexible, breathable, washable and mechanically robust. It is still a research prototype: resolution, power, electronics packaging, volume manufacturing, repair and long-term wear safety are not yet ready for an everyday consumer garment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When display, touch and computation grow along a fibre, clothing can become the interface instead of housing one.
en-US.doudouQuote: A washable prototype matters; scale manufacturing, power and repair are the next gates.

sources.title: Touch-sensing digital pixel fibre enables interactive garment GUI

zh-CN.headlineFact: 单个正电子被囚禁数月并冷却到最低能态
zh-CN.headlineView: 一正电子量子回旋器为高精度测量反物质磁矩铺路，寻找物质为何主导宇宙的微小差异
zh-CN.headlineFull: 单个正电子被囚禁数月并冷却到最低能态；一正电子量子回旋器为高精度测量反物质磁矩铺路，寻找物质为何主导宇宙的微小差异
zh-CN.intro: 西北大学团队建立了一正电子量子回旋器，把放射性衰变产生的高速正电子减速、筛选并困在电磁阱中，单个粒子可保存数月并冷却到最低能态。研究目标是高精度测量正电子磁矩，并与电子比较；电子与正电子的这一性质可以比质子与反质子磁矩精确约一万倍，因此任何可重复偏差都可能指向标准模型之外的物理，并帮助解释宇宙为何几乎只剩物质。10月21日发表的工作首先证明了平台能力，尚未报告物质与反物质不对称。放射源效率、粒子损失、系统误差与独立复现仍是后续精密测量的关键。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 基础物理的大问题，常常先被压缩成把一个粒子安静地留住几个月。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 平台已经成立，发现不对称仍要等真正的精密比较结果。

en-US.headlineFact: A single positron is trapped for months and cooled to its lowest energy state
en-US.headlineView: A one-positron quantum cyclotron opens a path to precision antimatter magnetic-moment tests and tiny clues to why matter dominates the Universe
en-US.headlineFull: A single positron is trapped for months and cooled to its lowest energy state; A one-positron quantum cyclotron opens a path to precision antimatter magnetic-moment tests and tiny clues to why matter dominates the Universe
en-US.intro: A Northwestern University team built a one-positron quantum cyclotron that slows positrons from radioactive decay, selects survivors and holds one particle in an electromagnetic trap for months before cooling it to its lowest energy state. The goal is to measure the positron's magnetic moment and compare it with the electron's. That property can be measured about 10,000 times more precisely for electrons and positrons than for protons and antiprotons, so a repeatable mismatch could point beyond the standard model and help explain why the Universe is overwhelmingly matter. The work published on October 21 establishes the platform; it does not yet report matter-antimatter asymmetry. Source efficiency, particle loss, systematic error and independent replication remain central to the precision test ahead.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A cosmic question can begin with the practical feat of keeping one particle quiet for months.
en-US.doudouQuote: The platform exists; an asymmetry claim must wait for the precision comparison itself.

sources.title: A single antimatter particle in a cage opens door to revolutionary physics

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界银行集团发布首份数字战略
zh-CN.headlineView: 连接、可负担设备与数据、数字服务与技能、AI基础四条路径，回应12亿青年与4.2亿岗位的缺口
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界银行集团发布首份数字战略；连接、可负担设备与数据、数字服务与技能、AI基础四条路径，回应12亿青年与4.2亿岗位的缺口
zh-CN.intro: 世界银行集团10月20日在首尔发布首份覆盖公共与私营部门能力的数字战略，重点是扩大连接、降低设备和数据成本、强化数字服务与技能，并帮助各国建立利用AI的基础。背景是未来10至15年发展中经济体约有12亿年轻人进入劳动年龄，而预计只能创造约4.2亿个岗位。战略把数字化放进基础设施与能源、农业、医疗、旅游和增值制造五个优先行业，希望帮助企业找到客户、提高生产率、获得融资并降低公共服务成本。文件给出方向而非自动产生就业；项目融资、网络可靠性、设备负担、数据治理、本地技能、市场竞争和小型AI能否适应资源约束决定最终效果。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 数字战略的价值，不在于多建一个平台，而在于让连接、技能和产业岗位同时增长。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 12亿人和4.2亿岗位是结构性缺口，AI只能在基础条件成立时帮忙。

en-US.headlineFact: The World Bank Group launches its first digital strategy
en-US.headlineView: Connectivity, affordable devices and data, digital services and skills, and AI foundations address a gap between 1.2 billion young workers and 420 million expected jobs
en-US.headlineFull: The World Bank Group launches its first digital strategy; Connectivity, affordable devices and data, digital services and skills, and AI foundations address a gap between 1.2 billion young workers and 420 million expected jobs
en-US.intro: The World Bank Group launched its first digital strategy in Seoul on October 20, combining public- and private-sector capabilities around four priorities: expand connectivity, make devices and data affordable, strengthen digital services and skills, and build foundations for countries to benefit from AI. Over the next 10 to 15 years, about 1.2 billion young people will reach working age in developing economies while those economies are projected to create roughly 420 million jobs. The strategy puts digital capability into infrastructure and energy, agribusiness, health care, tourism and value-added manufacturing to help firms reach customers, raise productivity, access finance and lower public-service costs. Direction does not automatically create jobs; finance, network reliability, affordability, data governance, local skills, competition and whether small AI fits constrained settings determine results.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A digital strategy matters when connectivity, skills and industry jobs grow together, not when one more platform appears.
en-US.doudouQuote: 1.2 billion people versus 420 million jobs is a structural gap; AI helps only when the foundations work.

sources.title: World Bank Group Launches First Digital Strategy to Expand Access and Create Jobs
